''See also: [[Ghostwind Hall Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[Ghostwind]] [[Hall]] is a residence and sanctuary established by [[Lindon]], [[Yerin]], and their companions to serve as a base of operations while they face external conflicts. The location is situated within a [[pocket world]] featuring an island made of pale stone and a sky characterized by swirling colors. While many original facilities within the realm were either incomplete or of little value, some components have proven practical for the group. The structure includes various functional areas, such as a [[sparring hall]] and large caverns used for training, as well as a central room located at the summit of [[Windfall]]. [[Lindon]] utilized the [[Void Icon]] to restore the house, and the environment is subject to physical shifts, such as trembling when restrictions are lifted or changes in how time flows through its entrance.}}

== Waybound ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[Ghostwind]] [[Hall]] is a location that [[Lindon]] recently completed working on and where he later materialized. The hall serves as a residence for [[Orthos]], who has spent months within its walls, and the sounds of his training can be heard from within. The facility contains a [[cycling]] room used by [[Yerin]] for her practice and is accessible through a [[portal]] located inside a doorway. During one instance, the air inside the hall boiled when an alarm sounded, and [[Mercy]] eventually strode back into the space where [[Yerin]] was present.}}
